Maria (CS): Heads-up — Verde Energy doing a weekend demo in EMEA on Sat 10:00 UTC. They asked for regional pin + temporary egress allowlist and a soft rate-lift for the demo window.
Elena - Verde Energy: thanks! Demo is a hard requirement for the renewal. Need 2x QPS for the demo window, and IPs allowed from our staging VPC 10.40.0.0/16 and partner CDN 52.55.12.0/24.
Maria (CS): Copy. Requested changes: increase per-minute rate_window from 600 -> 1200 for 4h, add CIDR allowlist, and pin region to eu-west-1 to keep latency <120ms. Also ask for auto-revoke after demo.
Ryan (NetEng): @Maria I'll provision CIDR rules and open peering. Quick Q — exact start/end and do you want an automatic revoke timer?
Elena - Verde Energy: Start 2024-06-22T10:00:00Z end 2024-06-22T14:00:00Z. Please auto-revoke 2h after end for safety (i.e. revoke at 16:00Z).
Sam (AE): Adding context — demo outcome ties directly to renewal conversation on Mon. If this goes well, they want to accelerate Dedicated talks. Please prioritize. :nerd_face:
OpsBot: Rate-limit change request created: RQ-49821 (owner: Maria). CIDRs queued for validation.
Ryan (NetEng): Pasting whitelist config I'll apply in staging then promote: ```allowed_cidrs:
 - 10.40.0.0/16
 - 52.55.12.0/24
region_pin: eu-west-1
auto_revoke: 2h
rate_window_minute: 1200
``` Applying at ~10:30 UTC to allow a 20m smoke test before demo.
Maria (CS): Can SRE confirm capacity for a potential spike? @Jordan (SRE)
Jordan (SRE): We have headroom on dedicated pool-3 (g4dn equiv). If they spike above ~4k rps we'd hit SLO risk. Suggest enabling soft-burst + fallback model variant 'redwood-medium' to avoid hard failures. We'll also turn on request-level tracing for the session.
Elena - Verde Energy: Fallback model is acceptable, but quality matters. Can you keep a short tokenization timeout and capture latency traces + sample outputs for post-demo QA?
Jordan (SRE): Set token timeout to 60s (was 30s), enabled tracing and sample logging (redact keys). We'll stream a few sample completions to the CS channel for quick checks.
Maria (CS): Great — I'll confirm to Elena and provide RQ-49821 and deployment window. Post-demo we'll gather latency / token-cost / quality metrics and capture customer feedback for the renewal pack. Thanks team :thumbsup:
Sam (AE): :thumbsup: good luck everyone — Maria, loop me in on the post-demo notes so I can reference them in renewal call.
Elena - Verde Energy: Appreciate the fast turnaround. We'll send a short test script beforehand.
Maria (CS): Please send test script by Fri 18:00 UTC. I'll coordinate the smoke test at 10:30 and share a post-smoke status here.
